messages.author: ad1a6abcb84542f8
messages.subject: help with geoJson and Shiny
parts:
Hello everyone,

I'm struggling trying to learn leaflet, Shiny, javascript and GIS-standards all at once and it has become a little hard/ slow.

I was working with map$addPolygon but later decided geoJson was more convenient to use. Now I'm not that sure anymore...

As a first step, I'm trying to replicate some (ideally would be all) of the functionalities in this leaflet example here in Shiny: http://leafletjs.com/examples/choropleth.html

With the help of the following projects/ demos and a lot of hours of reading (thanks for all the examples!):
- https://github.com/jcheng5/leaflet-shiny and 
- https://github.com/ramnathv/NYCBikeShare
- https://github.com/ramnathv/bikeshare/

I have managed to display my own polygons features with colors and popups using something similar to this piece of code (edited from the second/third demo):

L1$geoJson(toGeoJSON(data_), 
    onEachFeature = '#! function(feature, layer){
      layer.bindPopup(feature.properties.popup)
    } !#',
    style="#!function style(feature) {
             return {
               fillColor: feature.properties.fillColor,
               weight: 2,
               opacity: 1,
               color: 'white',
               dashArray: '3',
               fillOpacity: 0.7
             };
           } !#"  
)

Things that I am not sure how to implement are: (these referr to the leafletjs example above)

1. javascript functions like: highlightFeature(e), resetHighlight(e) and zoomToFeature(e)
(If I put them in an Index.html file, they work with the rest of the shiny app but I am not sure how to add them through ui.R and server.R files or what is the correct way to use them)

2. How to create and use global variables (for example "var geojson" to use resetHighlight(e) in the example and connect them to shiny.

3. build the Custom Info Control (if there is a shiny example, that would be enough)

I hope these questions are (a) relevant and (b) not-extremely-obvious... but if not, please do tell me, if possible with some documentation I can take a look at.

There are a million other things I do not understand but having some light on these ones would probably help me continue and maybe figure it out myself.

Last, but not least, thanks to everyone that is helping in this wonderful piece of software.

regards,

Franco

--
Sent from my netBook
